answer: I fixed `top_words()` in `stats/words.py` so tied counts now come out alphabetically. It sorts by count descending, then by word, and takes the first `n`. `bb-test` passes. The suite has one test, `test_ties_alphabetical`.

+++ b/stats/words.py

 def top_words(text, n):
     """The n most frequent lowercase words as (word, count); ties sorted alphabetically."""
     counts = Counter(text.lower().split())
